text:
mina: quick heads-up — cutoff for 1.14 is tomorrow @noon PT. Please keep changelog blurbs short and follow the tiny-template below. I'll be doing a sweep 1h before cutoff :pray:

mina: tiny-template (one line, imperative, component tag, PR)
```
[component] Short verb phrase describing change. (#1234)
```

mina: example:
```
[api] Simplify token routing for fallback models. (#4123)
```

jamie: got it — i'll trim my PRs tonight. does the template live in the repo or a doc?

mina: repo: docs/release/CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE.md and the console has the quick-copy. link: https://internal/docs/release/CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE.md

alex: two q's: 1) migration notes that are >1 line — allowed? 2) how strict about length?

mina: 1) migrations only if user-facing or infra-affecting. Put them under a "Notes:" section in the PR body, but keep the changelog blurb one line and add the tag `migration`. 2) aim for ~80 chars or fewer, but don't force a weird wording — clarity first.

jamie: small style nit: use imperative tense (Fix, Add, Remove). also avoid article "the" where it bloats.

alex: can we add a tiny lint check so reviewers get a red/green if format is off?

mina: yep, request sent earlier — repo has a pre-merge GH action `changelog-lint` that warns on shape/length/component. it's optional for now but reviewers should enforce.

alex: can someone paste the exact sed/perl one-liner to auto-trim to 80? saves manual fiddling.

jamie: here's a crude one to truncate the first line of a PR body to 80 chars (works ok):
```bash
sed -n '1p' PR_BODY.md | cut -c1-80 > PR_LINE_TRIMMED.txt
```

mina: ^ good enough for quick edits. if you want to keep link/PR number add them after trimming.

release-bot: Reminder: Changelog cutoff scheduled for 2026-03-18 19:00:00 UTC (tomorrow).

alex: thanks — i'll update my PR descriptions and add component tags. ping me if anything still flagged after the sweep.

mina: cheers. if you run into ambiguous component choices ping #eng-architecture, they'll advise. :rocket:
